# Segmented ITS analysis of the FLP series (generated by its_analysis.py)

2019-II uses the thesis-official cohort (48 enrolled, 22 approved).
Time axis: half-year index; calendar gaps preserved.

## Approval rate: segment descriptives

- baseline 2015-II..2019-II (n=7): mean 65.86, SD 18.60, range 44.00-96.00 pp
- 2020-I (ERT): 96.43 pp; 2020-II (intervention): 78.18 pp
- sustained 2021-II..2026-I (n=9): mean 91.12, SD 9.76, range 72.55-100.00 pp
- Welch t (sustained - baseline): diff +25.25 pp, t=3.26, df=8.6, p=0.0105
- Hedges g (semester-level points): 1.68
- variance ratio baseline/sustained: 3.63 (F-test p=0.0967; Brown-Forsythe p=0.1265)
- Mann-Kendall baseline: S=-5, z=-0.60, p=0.5480
- Mann-Kendall sustained: S=+15, z=1.47, p=0.1422

- sustained 2021-II..2026-I (n=9): mean 3.78, SD 0.27, range 3.43-4.18 grade pts

- Mann-Kendall sustained: S=+9, z=0.84, p=0.4017

- 2020-I approval 96.4% (27/28), mean 3.94; 2020-II approval 78.2% (43/55), mean 3.73
